lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Mg6Zn3Co3O12 (reduced formula Mg2ZnCoO4) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3m (No. 166), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co and Zn each adopt octahedral coordination by six O atoms, while Mg is four-coordinate to O and O centers are octahedrally coordinated by three Co and three Zn neighbors. The resulting neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and the validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Co and Zn octahedra, plus corner-sharing between Co octahedra and Mg polyhedra.
